scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Oh, it's you again.
So did you try finding
that nutcase scientist
who lives over in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
啊，又是你啊。
你去找過那個住在吉芬的
瘋科學家了嗎？

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 談談莫根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
You know where he lives
but didn't check it out? Hey,
he may be off his rocker, but
I guess most geniuses are
like that. Still, I think it'd be^FFFFFFss^000000 a good idea if you see him.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
你知道他住哪，
卻不去看看？嘿，
他雖然有點瘋，
但我想大多數天才
都是那樣的。不過，我覺得^FFFFFF去^000000見見他是個好主意。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
I mean...
It's only a matter
of time until a smart guy
like that creates something
truly miraculous, right?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
我是說...
像他那樣聰明的人，
遲早會創造出
真正奇蹟般的發明，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
...Hello?
Hellooo? Hey.
Hey! I'm talkin'
to you! Man, I hate
it when you adventurers
just shut up and space out...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
...喂？
喂？嘿。
嘿！我在跟你說話呢！
真討厭，你們這些冒險者
總是沉默不語，發呆走神...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Heya.
What's up?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗨。
有什麼事嗎？

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Talk about the solutions.
scripts.translation: 談談那些溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
When I was in Geffen
looking for magic items,
I heard rumors of this really
crazy scientist guy. So I got
curious, asked around, and
eventually found this guy.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
我之前在吉芬
尋找魔法物品時，
聽說了這個非常瘋狂的科學家。於是我感到好奇，四處打聽，
最終找到了這個人。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Boy, oh boy, this guy was
screwy. He didn't even know
I was there the whole time and
just kept mumbling this mumbo
jumbo while working on his
experiments. Words like, um...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
天哪，這傢伙
真夠瘋的。他完全沒注意到
我在那裡，只是一直嘟囔著
一些胡言亂語，同時在做他的實驗。那些詞大概是...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Yeah, he kept mumbling
words like ''Karvodailnirol''
and ''Detrimindexta.'' The
first time I heard it, I thought
it was just crazy talk, you know?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
對，他一直嘟囔著
“卡勒波迪”和
“帝特立米”之類的詞。
我第一次聽到時，
以為只是在說瘋話，你知道嗎？

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
But it turns out,
this Karvodailnirol
and Detrimindexta actually
exist. I think they're special
liquids that don't work quite
like any liquids we're used to.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
但事實證明，
卡勒波迪和帝特立米
確實存在。我想它們是特殊的液體，
性質與我們熟悉的任何液體都不同。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hey, this is one of
those solutions that
scientist kept mentioning.
You were able to get one
of these? Huh. Now, I have
no idea what to do with them...
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嘿，這是那個科學家
一直提到的溶液之一。
你居然弄到了其中一個？
嗯。現在，我完全不知道該怎麼處理它們...

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Ah, but that crazy
scientist would know.
I don't remember exactly
where he lives, but I know
he's in Geffen and that his
name is ^0000FFMorgenstein^000000.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
啊，但那個瘋狂的科學家
肯定知道。
我不記得他具體住哪，
但我知道他在吉芬，
而且他的名字是^0000FF莫根斯坦^000000。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Hmm... You better
go around Geffen and
around first. I know for
ask around first. I know for
sure that somebody knows
where you can find Morgenstein.
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗯...你最好
先在吉芬四處轉轉。
我知道肯定有人
知道在哪裡能找到莫根斯坦。

scripts.text:
[Merchant Louitz]
Um...
Good talking
to you pal. Uh,
see ya 'round. Take
care of yourself, 'kay?
scripts.translation:
[商人 路易茨]
嗯...
和你聊天很開心，朋友。呃，
回見。照顧好自己，好嗎？

It seems that our
paths yet cross again.
Coincidence? It's more
than that. This is ^0000FFfate^000000.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
看來我們的命運
再次交匯了。
巧合嗎？
不僅僅是巧合，這是^0000FF命運^000000。

scripts.text: Talk About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 談談莫根斯坦

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Have you not met
Morgenstein yet? He
lives on the second floor
of the Forge. Although we've
just met, I must warn you not
to get too close to him...
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
你還沒見過
摩根斯坦嗎？
他住在鍛造廠的二樓。
雖然我們才剛見面，
但我必須提醒你，
不要靠他太近...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Go then, and
may the tides of
destiny carry you
to where you must go.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
去吧，
願命運的洪流
將你帶往
你該去的地方。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Time flows gently
and subtly, but no
force in this world
can possibly stop it.
Mankind is not even a
mote in the grand scheme.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
時間緩緩而微妙地流逝，
但世間沒有任何力量
能夠阻止它。
人類在宏大的命運中
甚至只是一粒塵埃。

scripts.text: Talk
scripts.translation: 交談

scripts.text: Ask About Morgenstein
scripts.translation: 詢問關於摩根斯坦的事

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
To have goals and focus
is good, but to be obsessive
about one single thing can be
quite destructive. Relax, empty
your mind, and let yourself be
carried by the tides of destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
有目標並專注是好事，
但執著於一件事
可能會帶來破壞。
放鬆，放空你的思緒，
讓自己隨命運的洪流前行。

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
Morgenstein...?
The man is obsessed
with conquering the forces
that control our world. But
you seem to be curious about
him for some reason. Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
摩根斯坦...？
那個男人痴迷於
征服控制我們世界的力量。
但你似乎對他
有些好奇。嗯...

scripts.text:
[Aure Dupon]
It would be best if you
were to see Morgenstein
and judge his character for
yourself. You may find him in
the second floor of the Geffen
Forge. Go: It is your destiny.
scripts.translation:
[奧雷·杜邦]
最好是你親自去見見摩根斯坦，
判斷他的為人。
你可以在吉芬鍛造廠的二樓找到他。
去吧：這是你的命運。

scripts.text:

may the tides of
destiny carry you
to where you must go.
scripts.translation:

你該去的地方。

- Currently you're carrying -
- too many items with you. -
- Please try again -
- after you lose some weight. -
scripts.translation:
- 等等！！ -
- 您現在攜帶的物品 -
- 太多了。 -
- 請在減輕負重後 -
- 再試一次。 -

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
.....
Welcome.
Hehehehe....
Heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
.....
歡迎。
嘿嘿嘿嘿....
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿....

scripts.text: Ask about his research
scripts.translation: 詢問他的研究

scripts.text: Ask him to make a new solution.
scripts.translation: 請他製作新的溶液

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你肯定聽說過關於我研究的傳聞吧。是的！
不過既然你可能已經知道了，
我就直說吧，
我是說，沒什麼好隱瞞的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
其實，你可以說我的研究已經完成了！
沒有什麼是不可能的，對於我的天才來說！
哇哈哈哈，只是時間問題！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
你還在這裡嗎？
對了，你想知道關於我研究的事。
其實很簡單。
我只是想發明一種能融化一切的超級液體！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
是不是很有趣？
無論多強壯，你都打不碎石頭或鋼鐵，
但用我的新液體，
你可以融化它們，讓它們變得像泥巴一樣軟！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention. Heeheeheehee~!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
它還不能融化所有東西，
但我發現用我的發明，
你可以混合以前根本無法混合的東西。
嘿嘿嘿嘿~！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
You can make a whole lot of things that you'd never would have imagined possible! I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
你可以做出很多你從未想像過的東西！
用這種方法，我可以為你製作很多你從未想像過的東西...
只要你想要！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
內啡肽湧上我臉部的速度至少比平時快2.1倍！
啊！我太興奮了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
So...
You want me to make something totally new, huh? Hehhehheh! I love your sense of scientific adventure!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
所以...
你想讓我製作點全新的東西，是嗎？
嘿嘿嘿嘿！我喜歡你的科學冒險精神！

scripts.text: Counteragent
scripts.translation: 中和劑

scripts.text: Mixture
scripts.translation: 混合物

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooh...!
You want to make a Counteragent? Hohohohoho, let's see what we'll need...
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
哦...！
你想製作中和劑？
呵呵呵呵，讓我看看需要些什麼...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Oh, I remember, yes, Alcohol, and um, er, Detrimindexta and an Empty Bottle to put it it all in. Just these three items and 3000 zeny.
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
哦，我想起來了，是的，酒精，還有那個，呃，帝特立米藥水，以及一個用來裝它們的空瓶。
只需要這三樣東西和3000 Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Bwahahahah!
Oh, I just can't wait to make this! Are you ready to begin?
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
哇哈哈哈哈哈！
我簡直迫不及待要開始製作了！
你準備好開始了嗎？

scripts.text: Make
scripts.translation: 製作

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heuheuheuheuh.... not enough... not enough.. Haah...Haah... Go..... get the rest of the materials!
We'll postpone the fun until then... Heuheuheuheuheuh.
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿.... 不夠... 不夠... 哈...哈... 去... 去把剩下的材料找來！
等湊齊了再繼續我們的樂趣... 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ooooooooh...... heeheeheeheehee...... yes... like that...... yes... more... more........ heeheeheehee.
.... Aaah.... ahah... ha....ahahooooooooohoh!
scripts.translation:

哦哦哦哦哦...... 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿...... 是的... 就是這樣...... 是的... 更多... 更多........ 嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿。
.... 啊... 啊哈... 哈....啊哈哈哈哈哈！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Hohohoho.... not enough... not enough... haah...haah... go..... go get the rest of the materials!!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
呵呵呵呵.... 不夠... 不夠... 哈...哈... 去..... 去把剩下的材料找來！！

scripts.text:

Hee hee hee...
Haaaaah......
Oh? We're done already?!
scripts.translation:

嘿嘿嘿...
哈啊......
哦？我們已經完成了？！

Come back when
you're ready~

等你準備好了
再回來吧~

呵呵呵呵，讓我看看我們需要什麼...

再回來吧~
嘿...嘿烏嘿烏嘿烏...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heehee....heheheheh....
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿...嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee.... welcome. Hehehehe.... heeheeheeheehee....
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...歡迎。嘿嘿嘿嘿...嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿...

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Ah...?!
So sorry if I weirded you out. It's just... I haven't seen a living person in soooo long. So, er, what can I do for you??
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
啊...？！
抱歉，如果我讓你感到奇怪了。只是...我已經很久很久沒見過活人了。所以，呃，有什麼我可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: Ask about his research.
scripts.translation: 詢問他的研究

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheeheee...
You must have heard the rumors about my research. Yes! But since you probably know already, I'll tell you without hiding, I mean, there's nothing to hide.
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你肯定聽說過關於我研究的傳聞吧。是的！
不過既然你可能已經知道了，
我就直說吧，
我是說，沒什麼好隱瞞的。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Actually, you can say my research is complete! Nothing's impossible for my genius! Bwahaha, it's just a matter of time!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
其實，你可以說我的研究已經完成了！
沒有什麼是不可能的，對於我的天才來說！
哇哈哈哈，只是時間問題！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Are you still here? Right, you wanted to know about my research. It's actually very simple. I was just trying to invent a super liquid that can melt everything!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
你還在這裡嗎？
對了，你想知道關於我研究的事。
其實很簡單。
我只是想發明一種能融化一切的超級液體！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Isn't it interesting? No matter how strong you are, you can't break apart stone or steel, but with my new liquid, you can melt those things, making them soft like puddy!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
是不是很有趣？
無論多強壯，你都打不碎石頭或鋼鐵，
但用我的新液體，
你可以融化它們，讓它們變得像泥巴一樣軟！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
It can't melt everything yet, but I did find that you could combine things that you could never mix before with my invention.
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
它還不能融化所有東西，但我發現用我的發明，你可以混合以前根本無法混合的東西。

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
I can make you a lot of new things you never would have imagined using this method... as long as you want it!!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
用這種方法，我可以為你製作出許多你從未想像過的新東西……只要你想要！！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
The endorphins are rushing to my face at least 2.1 times faster than the usual rate! Ah! I'm so excited! I... I just can't hide it!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
內啡肽湧上我臉部的速度至少比平時快2.1倍！
啊！我太興奮了！我...我根本藏不住！

scripts.text:
[Chemist Morgenstein]
Heeheeheehee...
You're not here to be a test subject, are you? Probably not though. Not since my little 'accident.' Heeheeheeee~!
scripts.translation:
[化學家 摩根斯坦]
嘿嘿嘿嘿...
你不是來做實驗品的吧？大概不是吧。自從我的小“事故”之後，應該就不會了。嘿嘿嘿嘿~！
